Here is the code I'm using to plot:

ggplot(items, aes(x=measure, y=fit, color=form)) +
opts(title="Fit Statistic by Item Difficulty") +
xlab("Item Difficulty") +
ylab("Fit Statistic") +
geom_point() +
geom_hline(aes(yintercept=1.3, linetype=2))

Like this, the symbol in the legend is a dot with a line through it,
which is not what I want. If I remove the geom_hline line, the legend
symbol is just a dot, which IS what I want. Is this a valid bug? Perhaps
it's fixed in 0.9; Hadley mentioned yesterday that there were some fixes
to the legend symbol code in the new version, but he only noted symbol
size.

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: bug reporting?
parts: Stuart, I think the problem was that you tried to map 2 to linetype, because it was in aes(). Brandon's version set linetype=2, by moving it out of aes().
On Fri, Dec 2, 2011 at 12:44 PM, Brandon Hurr <brando...@gmail.com> wrote:

ggplot(items, aes(x=measure, y=fit, color=form)) +
 opts(title="Fit Statistic by Item Difficulty") +
 xlab("Item Difficulty") +
 ylab("Fit Statistic") +
 geom_point() +
 geom_hline(aes(yintercept=1.3), linetype=2, legend=F)

This works for me. 

2011/12/2 Stuart Luppescu <s...@ccsr.uchicago.edu>
ggplot(items, aes(x=measure, y=fit, color=form)) +
 opts(title="Fit Statistic by Item Difficulty") +
 xlab("Item Difficulty") +
 ylab("Fit Statistic") +
 geom_point() +
 geom_hline(aes(yintercept=1.3, linetype=2))
